props.name: isOpen
props.comment: Whether the dialog is open. Default `false`.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Disables both buttons while a confirm action is in flight.

props.name: title
props.comment: Dialog title (i18n key or literal — translated with a `_` fallback).

props.name: content
props.comment: Dialog body copy (i18n key or literal — translated with a `_` fallback).

props.name: confirmColor
props.comment: `"warning"` tints the confirm button destructive. Default `"primary"`.

props.name: translateOptions
props.comment: Interpolation params merged into the title/content translation (e.g. `smart_count`).
